modules.text: Root-cause dentistry for better sleep health comfort

modules.html:
At My Dear Dentist, you’ll always be greeted by the same friendly faces, honest advice, and a genuine commitment to your whole body health and comfort.

Meet your trusted Montrose dentists, Dr. Nour Amin and Dr. Mustafa Shinta, a husband-and-wife team who put relationships first. With over 20 years of combined experience and advanced training, we tailor every aspect of your care to what’s right for you.

Great care, rewarding from day one

We’ve created a special offer to help you start your care with confidence.
First Visit

Your first visit includes a complete exam, digital X-rays, and a routine cleaning, to give us a clear picture of your oral and whole-body health.

For new, non-insured patients.
Not sure where to begin? Our team is happy to help you choose the option that fits your needs.

modules.alt: Bright office interior with a sculpted wave-pattern wood ceiling, pendant lights, and floor-to-ceiling windows.

modules.html:
It’s all about you

As a family-owned practice, we’re here to build lasting relationships and deliver a truly personalized experience at every visit.

items.text: A top-rated team that listens, explains, and cares
Whole-body wellness woven into every treatment

modules.html:
Excellence in sleep dentistry

Our Montrose dentists, Dr. Nour Amin and Dr. Mustafa Shinta, offer custom, non-invasive solutions for snoring and sleep apnea, helping you sleep better and feel your best. We’ll help you treat the root cause of your airway concerns to restore your rest, energy, and health.

modules.alt: A woman rests peacefully on a soft pillow with her eyes closed and a hand near her face.

modules.html:

Book your $99 first visit

We love meeting new smiles!
Our $99 new patient special includes a comprehensive exam, routine cleaning, and our curated new patient welcome package to help you start strong at home.

Want to save
on every visit?

Our Membership Club makes quality dental care simple and affordable, no insurance required. Get exclusive savings, complimentary cleanings, and peace of mind all year long.

Plans start at just $25/month.
Our whole-body approach

Sleep Better, Feel Better

By addressing oral health issues like airway restriction and jaw alignment, we help improve your sleep and your daily energy and focus.

Calm the Inflammation

Gum disease and an imbalanced bite can trigger inflammation that affects your body. We focus on prevention to protect your heart, strengthen your immune system, and support wellness.

Tailored to You

We look beyond your teeth. From nutrition and stress to your medical history and lifestyle, we design personalized care that works with your daily routine — and helps you feel your best.

modules.html:
General Dentistry

Preventive and restorative care for every stage of life, from routine cleanings and exams to fillings, crowns, and more. We help you maintain a healthy and strong smile.

Sleep Apnea & Bruxism

Chronic headaches or trouble sleeping? Our Montrose sleep dentistry team offers custom treatment for sleep apnea and bruxism with oral appliances that improve airflow, protect your smile, and support a whole-body approach to better health and rest.

modules.alt: A bearded man sleeps soundly on his side, head sunken into a striped pillow.
A patient in a blue dental bib smiles brightly while seated in the treatment chair.

modules.html:
Cosmetic Dentistry

Boost your confidence with a brighter, more beautiful smile. We offer veneers, Invisalign, and more, customized to your goals and designed to look naturally stunning.

Restorative Dentistry

Rebuild your smile with expert care. Whether you need a single tooth repaired or full-mouth reconstruction, we offer advanced solutions, including dental implants, to restore function, comfort, and confidence.

modules.alt: Empty treatment room with a reclined dental chair facing wide windows onto a tree-lined street.
Compact dental operatory with a chair, equipment cart, and orange stool beside a sunlit window.

modules.html:
Extractions & wisdom teeth removal

Gentle, expert tooth removal when it’s needed, including wisdom teeth. We use advanced healing techniques like Platelet Rich Fibrin (PRF) to minimize pain, speed recovery, and help prevent common complications after surgery.
Our Services
Excellence at every step
Welcome to your first visit! Enjoy a short tour, cozy amenities (blanket, headphones, streaming TV), and a fully digital, stress-free check-in.
We review your health and dental history, lifestyle factors (including sleep, diet, and TMJ), and personal goals, ensuring your care is truly personalized.
Digital x-rays, intraoral photos, gum and bite evaluation, and a thorough dental exam. For surgical care, we use Platelet Rich Fibrin (PRF) to support faster, smoother healing.
We listen to your concerns, discuss your goals, and provide a standard hygiene cleaning, or create a clear plan if deeper care is needed.
You’ll leave with a personalized treatment plan, clear cost estimates, and same-day treatment offered when possible. No pressure, no surprises.

“At My Dear Dentist, everything we do comes from a place of love: for our patients, our craft, and our community. As a husband-and-wife team, we’ve created a space where you feel truly cared for, seen, and supported like family.”
– Dr. Shinta & Dr. Amin

Your Questions Answered

items.title: What makes My Dear Dentist different from other Houston dentists?
items.html: We combine advanced dental care with a whole-body wellness approach — all in a warm, family-owned practice. You’ll see the same trusted faces at every visit and experience personalized, comfort-first care designed just for you.

items.title: Do you accept new patients?
items.html: Absolutely! We welcome new patients of all ages. Our $99 New Patient Special includes an exam, routine cleaning, and a welcome package to help you get started on your path to a healthier smile.

items.title: I struggle with dental anxiety. How do you help?
items.html: You’re not alone — and we’re here to help. We offer a calming environment with cozy amenities (blankets, headphones, streaming TV), clear communication, and gentle care. We also provide sedation dentistry options when needed.

items.title: Do you offer cosmetic dentistry?
items.html: Yes! Whether you want a brighter smile or a complete smile makeover, we’ll create a treatment plan tailored to your goals.

items.title: How can a dentist help with sleep problems?
items.html: Many sleep issues, like snoring and sleep apnea, are related to oral and airway health. Our Montrose dentists offer non-invasive dental solutions that can improve your breathing and help you get better, healthier sleep.

items.title: Do you treat the whole family?
items.html: Yes! We provide comprehensive dental care for children, teens, adults, and seniors — all in one place. Whether it’s preventive care, restorative treatment, or cosmetic services, your family’s smiles are in expert hands.

items.title: What areas of Houston does My Dear Dentist serve?
items.html:
Our office is at 1540 West Alabama St, Suite 200, Houston, TX 77006, in the heart of Montrose. We care for patients from West University, Rice Village, Boulevard Oaks, Southampton, River Oaks, Greenway/Upper Kirby, Midtown, Neartown, and the Museum District.

You can see the full list on our areas we serve page.

items.title: How far is your office from West University or Boulevard Oaks?
items.html: Not far at all. Our office is in Montrose at 1540 West Alabama, Suite 200, just north of Highway 59, a short drive from West University, Rice Village, Boulevard Oaks, and Southampton. River Oaks and Greenway/Upper Kirby are just as close. You can read more about each one on our areas we serve page.

items.title: Do you see patients from River Oaks and Greenway/Upper Kirby?
items.html: Yes. Both sit right next to Montrose, and we see patients from each for everything from cleanings and Invisalign to dental implants and sleep apnea care. Call (281) 653-1818 or book online to find a time that works.
